title: BofA, JPMorgan, Oppenheimer Name Their 3 Favorite AI Stocks, One Has a $255 Target
excerpt: BofA, JPMorgan & Oppenheimer name their top 3 AI stocks. See the $255 Palantir target, $365 Amazon call and $400 Lam Research price target.
content_html:
Top Wall Street analysts at Bank of America, JPMorgan and Oppenheimer have identified three AI stocks they believe remain well-positioned for further gains following strong quarterly earnings.

Their bullish outlooks reflect expectations that AI investment will remain strong despite ongoing concerns about valuations and the sustainability of spending.

3 AI Stocks TipRanks' Top Analysts Are Most Bullish On in August 2026

The picks, Palantir Technologies, Amazon and Lam Research, span different parts of the AI ecosystem, from enterprise software to cloud computing and semiconductor manufacturing.

Palantir's Commercial AI Business Continues to Accelerate

Bank of America analyst Mariana Perez Mora reiterated a Buy rating on Palantir with a $255 price target after the company's second-quarter results exceeded expectations.

US commercial revenue surged 149% year over year, increasing its share of total revenue to nearly 40%, up from roughly 30% a year ago. The company also expanded its US commercial customer base 35% to 653, while trailing 12-month revenue per customer climbed 76% to $3.5 million.

Following the results, Palantir raised full-year guidance and now expects at least 134% US commercial revenue growth. Mora also increased her 2026–2028 revenue and earnings forecasts, citing stronger contract value and deeper customer relationships.

She views Palantir's commercial business as the company's primary growth engine, driven by customers seeking measurable returns from AI deployments. Shares closed near $172 on August 7.

Mora's $255 target therefore implies a 48% climb above current levels.

Amazon's AI Momentum Boosts AWS Outlook

JPMorgan analyst Doug Anmuth raised Amazon's price target to $365 from $330 while maintaining a Buy rating and naming the stock a Best Idea.

Amazon Web Services delivered 37% revenue growth during the second quarter, its fastest expansion in 18 quarters. Meanwhile, while companywide forex-neutral revenue increased 20%, the strongest pace in five years.

AWS backlog climbed to $496 billion, up nearly 2.5x year over year and 36% sequentially. Anmuth attributed the momentum to growing AI workloads, continued demand for core cloud services and Amazon's custom AI chips.

He modestly lifted his 2026 and 2027 forecasts, arguing that Amazon's AI investments continue to generate attractive returns.

A move to $365 would imply a 33% move above $274, where shares closed on Friday.

Lam Research Could Benefit From the Next AI Chip Expansion

Oppenheimer analyst Edward Yang maintained a Buy rating on Lam Research with a $400 price target after the semiconductor equipment maker beat fiscal fourth-quarter expectations.

content_html_zh:
美国银行、摩根大通和奥本海默的华尔街顶级分析师已经确定了三只人工智能股票，他们认为在强劲的季度收益之后仍有望进一步上涨。

他们的乐观前景反映了尽管人们对估值和支出可持续性持续担忧，但人工智能投资仍将保持强劲的预期。

TipRanks 顶级分析师最看好的 3 只 2026 年 8 月人工智能股票

Palantir Technologies、亚马逊和 Lam Research 所选择的公司涵盖了人工智能生态系统的不同部分，从企业软件到云计算和半导体制造。

Palantir的商业人工智能业务持续加速

在 Palantir 第二季度业绩超出预期后，美国银行分析师 Mariana Perez Mora 重申了对 Palantir 的买入评级，目标价为 255 美元。

美国商业收入同比飙升 149%，占总收入的比例从一年前的约 30% 增加到近 40%。 该公司还将其美国商业客户群扩大了 35%，达到 653 个，而过去 12 个月每个客户的收入增长了 76%，达到 350 万美元。

公布结果后，Palantir 上调了全年指引，目前预计美国商业收入增长至少 134%。 莫拉还上调了 2026-2028 年的收入和盈利预测，理由是合同价值更强，客户关系更深入。

她将 Palantir 的商业业务视为公司的主要增长引擎，由寻求人工智能部署可衡量回报的客户推动。 8 月 7 日，该股收盘价接近 172 美元。

因此，Mora 的 255 美元目标意味着比当前水平上涨 48%。

亚马逊的 AI 势头提振了 AWS 的前景

摩根大通分析师道格·安穆斯 (Doug Anmuth) 将亚马逊的目标股价从 330 美元上调至 365 美元，同时维持“买入”评级，并将该股票评为“最佳创意”。

亚马逊网络服务第二季度收入增长 37%，是 18 个季度以来最快的扩张速度。 与此同时，全公司的外汇中性收入增长了 20%，为五年来最强劲的增幅。

AWS 积压订单攀升至 4,960 亿美元，同比增长近 2.5 倍，环比增长 36%。 Anmuth 将这一势头归因于不断增长的人工智能工作负载、对核心云服务和亚马逊定制人工智能芯片的持续需求。

他适度上调了 2026 年和 2027 年的预测，认为亚马逊的人工智能投资将继续产生有吸引力的回报。

升至 365 美元意味着股价将上涨 33%，高于周五收盘价 274 美元。

Lam Research 可能会从下一次 AI 芯片扩展中受益

在半导体设备制造商 Lam Research 超出第四财季预期后，Oppenheimer 分析师 Edward Yang 维持对 Lam Research 的买入评级，目标价为 400 美元。
